input.quote: Company acknowledges that Contractor provides consulting and development services to other clients, and agrees that nothing in this Agreement shall be deemed or construed to prevent Contractor from delivering on such business.
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds us. Section 4(b) preserves Contractor's freedom to serve other clients, which is a restriction-free provision from our side; the only limit on us is a use restriction on Contractor's own proprietary materials, not a restraint on our business.

input.quote: Company agrees to retain Contractor to perform the consulting services for Company, on a task by task basis (the "Services")
input.rationale: The engagement is task-by-task under Statements of Work with no sole-source, exclusivity or "all requirements" language binding us; we remain free to use other suppliers.
